notes: Insomnia Cookies' four San Francisco stores, named in issue #278, read on 2026-09-12. The store pages under https://insomniacookies.com/store/<slug> are a client-rendered shell that prints no address, so the listings come from the GraphQL API behind them — POST https://api.insomniacookies.com/graphql, `storeBySlug(where:{slug:$slug})` — which answers unauthenticated; `storeSearch`, the store finder's own query, does not. The sitemap's 378 store slugs were read twice on 2026-09-12 and the two reads agreed field for field; four stores give San Francisco as their city, the same four the issue lists, and the nearest other California store is in San Jose. The API publishes two sets of hours per store, Retail and Delivery; the panel takes Retail, the hours the shop is open, and the two differ by fifteen minutes at opening. The store record carries no category — `metaTitle`, `metaHeading` and `metaDescription` are empty or null on all four — so no entry publishes `kinds`: the one blurb that calls a store a bakery is the Kearny Street one, and applying that word to the other three would be ours rather than the directory's. The `blurb`, `storefrontImage` and delivery-range fields describe the merchant and its catchment rather than the building and stay off the pages. The issue's referral programme is a code, Stanft6246, entered by hand in the sign-up form's "Referral code (optional)" field — no link carries it — so the `insomniacookies` REFERRALS row holds both the code and Insomnia Cookies' own address, and the panel prints the code to copy beside the button. One REFERRALS row for the chain.

coverage.remaining: None. Four of the 378 stores in the sitemap give San Francisco as their city; the other California stores are in Chico, Claremont, Davis, Irvine, Los Angeles (three), Sacramento, San Diego (two), San Jose, San Luis Obispo, Santa Barbara, Santa Cruz and South Lake Tahoe.
